propositions: _diagnose_non_killed executes mutmut run without sandbox wrapper, allowing unsandboxed mutant code execution with unrestricted filesystem write access
non-killed mutants (survived, timed out, or errored) are re-run in _diagnose_non_killed and represent the highest-risk subset for destructive behavior
_diagnose_non_killed omits both mutation_sandbox.wrap and sandbox_env hardening, leaving HOME variable unrestricted unlike execute_shard call sites
AST call-site-binding tests in e668 failed to detect this vulnerability because they scanned only execute_shard and did not check for mutmut run invocations elsewhere in the module
wrapping and hardening the _diagnose_non_killed mutmut run call with identical allow-list contract (root, basetemp) and sandbox_env as execute_shard resolves the issue
